verses.text: Sb'ochajpax junok altar t'a te' chemte' nab'a akakia, lajannhej tz'aj yechel schanhil pak'anh. Chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro tz'aj junjun pak'anh, jun metro yet' 25 kentímetro tz'aj schaanhil.
Sb'ochajk'e junjun sch'aak t'a junjun schikintak. Ha juntzanh sch'aak chi' yaman tz'aj yet' jun altar chi', spichchaj te' t'a k'een bronke.

Masanil jantak syamk'ab'il altar chi', nab'a bronkeokabi: Haton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab', k'een tenedor yet' pax yet'tal b'aj tz'em te tzak'ak'.
Sb'opax junok k'een malla nab'a bronke, tz'ochpax junjun argolla bronke t'a junjun yeskinail k'een.
Tz'elk'och k'een yeskinail chi' t'a spatiktak jun altar chi' t'a yalanh jun oyanoch t'a stitak. Ha k'een malla chi', t'a snanhal jun altar chi' sb'ojiem k'een.
Sb'opax juntzanhok sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi'. Ha te' akakia tz'ochi, tz'ochpax bronke t'a spatik te'.
Ha te' sb'akhlab'il chi', yowalil tzek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a schab'il pak'anh yik wach' sb'akhjib'ati.
Ha jun altar chi', olan tz'ajkan yool, icha yechel ix in ch'ox t'ayach t'a jolom witz tik.

Sb'ochajpax k'apak kortina lino te wach' b'ayb'il, yik tz'och oyan smakulok yamaq'uil ay t'a spatiktak in kajnub' chi'. Ha t'a jun pak'anh t'a stojolal sur, 45 metro tz'ajb'at t'inhan k'apak kortina chi'.
Tz'och 20 te' oy, 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke, haxo t'a schon junjun te' oy chi', tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay.

Icha pax chi' t'a stojolal norte, yowalil tz'ochpax k'apak kortina t'a sk'atul chi' smasanil. 45 metro tz'aji, 20 pax te' yoyal tz'ochi yet' 20 sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronke, tz'em jun k'een nab'a plata, ayoch juntzanh argolla t'ay t'a schon junjun te' oy chi'.
Axo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, a k'apak kortina tz'och t'ay, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo tz'aj sat yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax lajunhe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Axo pax t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a jun amak' chi', 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat. Tz'ochpax k'apak kortina t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh sti' amak' chi', ay uke' metro k'apak kortina tz'ochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Anheja' t'a junxo pak'anh sti', ay pax uke' metro k'apak kortina tz'ochi, ay oxe' oy yet' oxe' sb'akhnub'al yich.

Axo t'a sti' amak' chi', ata' sb'ojioch junok k'apak kortina nab'a lino b'ayb'il, nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak. Sb'oji yelwanub' k'apak yuj junok jelan sb'oani. Ha t'a anh k'ik'mutz'inak ch'al, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al sb'ochaj yelwanub' chi'.
Masanil te' oy t'a spatik yichanh amak' chi', tz'em k'een k'een nab'a plata ayoch argolla t'ay t'a schon te'. Axo pax sb'akhnub'al yich te', nab'a bronke.

Ha jun amak' chi', 45 metro sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, lajannhej schapak'anhil. Axo pax k'apak kortina ayk'e t'a chaanh, chab' metro yet' 25 kentímetro steel k'apak. Ha k'apak kortina chi', haton lino wach' b'ayb'il. Axo sb'akhnub' yich te oy chi', nab'a bronke.
Masanil yestakail in kajnub' chi' yet' estaka ayoch t'a amak' chi', nab'a bronke tz'aji.
Al t'a heb' etisraelal to syik'kot akeite heb', haton akeite wach' tz'el t'a sat te' oliwo, yik wach' aynhej yakeiteal juntzanh kandil.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yuninal ayoch t'a yib'anh sb'oanoch sk'ak'al kandil chi', yik wach' kopanel sk'ak'al t'a wichanh tzek' ak'wal t'a yol mantiado b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a t'a yichanhelta k'apak kortina ayoch yenhulok te' skaxail in trato. Ha jun tik, junelnhej ley tz'ajkan t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik yet' pax t'a heb' eyinhtilal.
